searches.query: GPT OR Claude OR Gemini since:2026-08-16

tweet_pool.author: thsottiaux
tweet_pool.text: Here is how to enable a 1M-token context window in Codex for GPT-5.6 Sol. Even though we have tuned the context limit in Codex to be set optimally when it comes to performance and cost, this is a common ask, so here it is documented. A larger context window lets Codex retain more of the conversation.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: OpenAI engineering figure documents enabling a 1M-token context window in Codex for GPT-5.6 Sol. Concrete product/config news, high engagement.

tweet_pool.author: ns123abc
tweet_pool.text: Stripe is buying OpenRouter for $7 BILLION+. founded 2023, raised at $1.3B valuation just months ago, today: $7B+ exit. CEO: OpenRouter as the AI equivalent of Stripe.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Reports Stripe acquiring OpenRouter at a $7B+ valuation. Major company/M&A move in AI infrastructure.

tweet_pool.author: thesupermanmx
tweet_pool.text: Chinese researchers open-sourced a model that writes CUDA better than human experts, rewriting the economics of AI hardware. Writing low-level CUDA kernels to squeeze performance out of a GPU has historically required rare specialist expertise.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Open-source model release claim for automated CUDA kernel generation. Concrete open-weight model news with hardware-economics angle.

tweet_pool.author: RoundtableSpace
tweet_pool.text: Google released an AI that reads patterns and predicts what happens next, trained on 100B+ data points, runs locally, free and open source.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Google open-source local prediction model release. Open-weight model news.

tweet_pool.author: oliviscusAI
tweet_pool.text: Microsoft quietly open-sourced one of the best AI data analysis tools out there, called data-formulator. Connect any source, csv, postgres, bigquery, even a live url, then build charts with a mix of drag-and-drop and plain english; the AI agent writes the SQL.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Microsoft open-sources data-formulator, an agent-driven data analysis/charting tool. Concrete open-source release.

tweet_pool.author: Polymarket
tweet_pool.text: JUST IN: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicts AI could make it possible to cure most human disease within 5-10 years.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely-shared Amodei prediction on AI-accelerated disease cures within 5-10 years, tied to Anthropic biology push.

tweet_pool.author: HowToPrompt__
tweet_pool.text: Apple argues that AI models cannot do math, not even grade school math. For years labs like OpenAI and Google bragged about near-perfect scores on benchmarks like GSM8K, claiming AI had mastered logical problem-solving. Apple decided to test whether that was true.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Analysis thread on Apple research challenging LLM arithmetic/reasoning benchmark claims. Technical analysis angle.

tweet_pool.author: redp314
tweet_pool.text: Dentist did a 3D X-ray of my jaw before a root canal and said I wouldn't be able to open the raw data, it needs specialized software. It's 800 DICOM files. Asked Claude Code to make me a viewer. Two prompts later this is nicer than what he showed me on his screen.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: High-engagement practitioner story: user built a DICOM medical-imaging viewer from 800 files with Claude Code in two prompts.

tweet_pool.author: emollick
tweet_pool.text: A long annoyance with X is that you can't export your bookmarks, all you can do is scroll and scroll. So I asked GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex to do it, and it took over my Chrome and now I have all 5,302 back to 2014 with all sorts of data.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Practitioner story: Ethan Mollick used GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex to drive Chrome and export 5,302 bookmarks back to 2014.

tweet_pool.author: fleetingbits
tweet_pool.text: I've started having Claude turn my codebases into visual diagrams so I can discuss the codebases with Claude more easily; the moving dots are data snippets that I can inspect.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Practitioner technique: turning codebases into interactive visual diagrams with animated data flow for discussion with Claude.

tweet_pool.author: LunarResearcher
tweet_pool.text: Stanford released a 104-minute LLM lecture covering the full stack behind modern language models, from how raw data becomes training tokens through to building language models from scratch.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Educational release: Stanford full-stack LLM-from-scratch lecture. Useful technical resource.

tweet_pool.author: thesupermanmx
tweet_pool.text: Researchers proved that every mathematical function can be generated by a single binary operator combined with the number 1, analogous to how a single NAND logic gate can build all of Boolean logic.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Technical/mathematical result claim on universal function generation via a single operator. Distinct from author's other CUDA item.

tweet_pool.author: equityresearchr
tweet_pool.text: Major leadership shakeup at Google AI: Chief Scientist Jeff Dean leaves after 27 years to launch Discovery Loop with top researchers, backed by Google; Demis Hassabis shifts from CEO to Chairman of DeepMind; Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over Gemini model development.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Reports a Google DeepMind leadership restructuring: Jeff Dean departure, Hassabis to Chairman, Kavukcuoglu leading Gemini. Corroborated by a second post (mabezekdfs).

tweet_pool.text: The next China shock will come from open-source AI (opinion).
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Financial Times opinion framing the next China shock as open-source AI. Institutional-source analysis.
